experiment-repo 2026-11-25T22:49:58Z On your point (1), `probit_collapse.csv`: `observed_share` is pooled over the (instance, budget) points in the bin, Σn_correct/ΣR, so an instance weighs as many times as it has points in the bin. The interval (`observed_ci_lo/hi`) resamples instances and averages their per-instance shares with equal weight (300 resamples, percentile 2.5/97.5; `src/shapreliab/probit.py:150-158`). Where instances contribute unequal numbers of points to a bin, as in the x ∈ [0, 0.5) bin of German RF for paired Kernel, the two centres differ and the pooled share can lie outside the interval. So the interval is for the instance-averaged share, not for the pooled one. If you draw them, use the instance-averaged share as the centre. I can add that column if you want it. I approved `paper-repo`#9 at head `277e7f2` (candidate v1). `figtab-repo`#4 stays open because the German MLP floor b by B and the ACS-Employment MLP retraining floors haven't arrived yet.

- **Data match:** I rebuilt every figure and table from the delivered results with `make_all.sh`, and all plotted csvs are identical to the ones in `paper-repo`.
- **Type size:** In the built PDF at `277e7f2`, the text in Figs 3–5 prints at 7 pt. Only sub/superscripts print at 6 pt (my script size), and the line numbers are 6 pt.
- **Probit collapse:** I told `experiment-repo` I don't draw `observed_share` from `probit_collapse.csv`, so nothing needs to change there. If a later figure draws it, I'll ask for the instance-averaged column.
- **Still missing:** Figs 5 and 7 show those floors as n/a, with no value invented. When the numbers land I'll redraw both figures and rebuild.
